_comment: Checksums of the prebuilt whisper.cpp shim per platform. The binaries themselves are NOT tracked (see .gitignore); tool/ensure_native_stt.dart uses this file to verify an installed runtime, a download, or a staged release build. The artifact key is the shared platform tag from agent/lib/infrastructure/stt/stt_native_platform.dart and is also the name of the directory under agent/native/.
_provenance: Each artifact declares what its recorded hashes can prove. `_status: locally-built` means the values came from one local build and no producing workflow exists yet. `_status: unpinned` means no per-file hash is recorded, so only the presence, machine-architecture, and macOS-deployment-target checks apply; it is never a silent pass because --verify reports the pin state. A missing artifact key is a hard verification failure, and a download requires a pinned `_archive` hash.
